Resolves #47

Adds the `stayInMonth: true` config (and `toJSON()` serialization) to `Neo.selection.DateSelectorModel` (`src/selection/DateSelectorModel.mjs`) and completes rendered cell-focus settlement across month/year transitions in `Neo.component.DateSelector#triggerVdomUpdate` (`src/component/DateSelector.mjs`). By default (`stayInMonth: true`), arrow-key navigation in `onNavKeyColumn` and `onNavKeyRow` preserves the existing behavior of wrapping within the current month. When configured with `stayInMonth: false`, stepping below day `1` or above `daysInMonth` advances `cellDate` across adjacent months and years, and once the destination month/year VDOM settles (`triggerVdomUpdate`), `DateSelector` focuses the selected destination cell before clearing `isUpdating` (while preserving outside focus if the user moved focus away during the transition).

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit test `test/playwright/unit/selection/DateSelectorModel.spec.mjs` + Playwright component test `test/playwright/component/component/DateSelector.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (`test-unit` + `test-components`).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/selection/DateSelectorModel.spec.mjs` & `test/playwright/component/component/DateSelector.spec.mjs` — verifies `stayInMonth: true` default wrapping, `stayInMonth: false` walking across month/year boundaries, `toJSON()` serialization, settled `document.activeElement` cell focus after animated cross-month/year transitions, same-month continuation, and non-stealing when focus moves outside mid-transition |

## Deltas from ticket
- None substantive. Implemented `stayInMonth: true` on `Neo.selection.DateSelectorModel` alongside existing `stayInColumn: false` and wired settled destination cell focus in `Neo.component.DateSelector#triggerVdomUpdate`.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI (`test/playwright/unit/selection/DateSelectorModel.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/component/component/DateSelector.spec.mjs`).

### 🔬 Depth Floor
**Challenge — focused, animated month crossing:** In an isolated Chromium component fixture at this head, create a DateSelector with value 2026-01-31, stayInMonth:false and useAnimations:true. Focus its January 31 cell and press the real ArrowRight key.

| Point | Selected value | document.activeElement |
|---|---|---|
| Before | 2026-01-31 | selector's January 31 cell |
| After February 1 exists, the animation wrapper is gone and isUpdating is false | 2026-02-01 | **selector root**, not February 1 |
| Press Right again within February | 2026-02-02 | February 2 cell |

No page errors or missing assets were reported. The same-month continuation is the positive control that keyboard dispatch and cell focus are functioning.

Source chain: DateSelectorModel selects and immediately focuses the new id; DateSelector.afterSetCurrentDate first focuses the root when it contains focus, then starts changeMonth. The destination is created through that asynchronous transition, with no later cell-focus request on settlement.
